name: evlicense-cursor-workspace
description: EV License Management System - Cross-Platform Workspace with NFC Support

scripts.build:all: npm run build:v1 && npm run build:v2
scripts.build:win: npm run build:v1 -- --win && npm run build:v2 -- --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:v1 -- --mac && npm run build:v2 -- --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:v1 -- --linux && npm run build:v2 -- --linux
scripts.rebuild:all: npm run rebuild:v1 && npm run rebuild:v2
scripts.install:all: npm install --ignore-scripts && cd EVLicenseDesktop && npm install --ignore-scripts && cd ../EVLicenseDesktopV2 && npm install --ignore-scripts
scripts.install:v1: npm install --ignore-scripts && cd EVLicenseDesktop && npm install --ignore-scripts
scripts.install:v2: npm install --ignore-scripts && cd EVLicenseDesktopV2 && npm install --ignore-scripts
scripts.install:clean: npm run clean:manual && npm run install:all
scripts.install:electron: cd EVLicenseDesktop && npm install electron@^37.2.5 --save-dev --ignore-scripts && cd ../EVLicenseDesktopV2 && npm install electron@^37.2.5 --save-dev --ignore-scripts
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules EVLicenseDesktop/node_modules EVLicenseDesktopV2/node_modules package-lock.json EVLicenseDesktop/package-lock.json EVLicenseDesktopV2/package-lock.json
scripts.clean:manual:
if exist node_modules rmdir /s /q node_modules && if exist EVLicenseDesktop
ode_modules rmdir /s /q EVLicenseDesktop
ode_modules && if exist EVLicenseDesktopV2
ode_modules rmdir /s /q EVLicenseDesktopV2
ode_modules && if exist package-lock.json del package-lock.json && if exist EVLicenseDesktop\package-lock.json del EVLicenseDesktop\package-lock.json && if exist EVLicenseDesktopV2\package-lock.json del EVLicenseDesktopV2\package-lock.json
scripts.test:all: npm run test:cross-platform && npm run test:full
scripts.check:deps: npm audit && cd EVLicenseDesktop && npm audit && cd ../EVLicenseDesktopV2 && npm audit
scripts.update:deps: npm update && cd EVLicenseDesktop && npm update && cd ../EVLicenseDesktopV2 && npm update

author: Talukdar & Son's, Software Eng. Asif Hossain
